name: bedrock-addon-kit
description: Everything to build a Minecraft Bedrock add-on from scratch with Claude Code: custom items, tools, armor, blocks, entities, NPCs, UIs, world content, dimensions, biomes and Vibrant Visuals with templates, packaging, world templates and Marketplace rules, an error dictionary and debugging guide, a full JSON component reference, Blockbench and Script API 2.x guidance, an add-on generator, a pack checker, and a dated record of current versions and creator features.
